channel.title: Farrelly Atkinson Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: Oscar Onley’s move to Ineos Grenadiers confirmed, as British star says “opportunity to represent the team of my home country was one I couldn’t refuse”
item.description: The 23-year-old Scottish stage racer is set to leave Picnic PostNL following a breakthrough year that saw him finish fourth overall at the Tour de France

item.title: How Cycle to Work was saved: The battle to stop Labour’s Budget spending cap + The year in cycling reviewed
item.description: On a Christmassy edition of the podcast, we go behind the scenes to delve into Labour’s plans to reintroduce a Cycle to Work spending cap (and how it was stopped), while looking back on the biggest cycling stories of 2025

item.title: Apple Watch Ultra 3
item.description: An evolution over a revolution, and an excellent watch for on and off the bike 9/10

item.title: A festive Bike at Bedtime: Steve’s 1984 Concorde Astore
item.description: Steve takes us on a retro ride back to Christmas 1984 and a short-lived fling - and the break up - with his Concorde Astore

item.title: Five Cool Things at Christmas 2025/26: Show us your cycling-related gifts for the chance to win some cycling schwag!
item.description: Simply show us what your best cycling Christmas presents were this year and win a prize, it’s that simple! We’ll be judging after Christmas day and revealing the winners on 30th December, good luck…

item.title: Ergon BT Orthocell bar tape
item.description: Dense foam tape gives a plush ride for your hands 8/10

item.title: DealClincher x Zwift Big New Year sale! Biggest savings ever on Zwift Ride with Kickr Core and save £50 on the Wahoo Kickr Core 2
item.description: Kick-start 2026 with Zwift’s Big New Year sale - big discounts on smart trainers and indoor bikes. Don't miss out...

item.title: Deuter Cabezon SB 16
item.description: Well-made, stable, high-capacity waterproof saddlebag that’s great when packed just right 7/10

item.title: Meet the Fukushima brothers, past stars of Asian road racing
item.description: Shinichi and Koji Fukushima were amongst the biggest stars and characters in early 2000s bike racing in Asia, and yet their great achievements and stories seldom made page space in western cycling media. This is their beguiling story...

item.title: Near Miss of the day 942: "It was the most frightening moment I've ever had on my bike"
item.description: Kent Police chose to take no action against the professional driver who almost caused a shocking collision with a cyclist, the rider involved left frustrated the force showed "no interest in addressing the deficient driving"
